surveys.name: Single Fire Door Inspection
surveys.description: Inspect the condition and performance of a single fire door.

questions.label: Is the door leaf free from damage?
questions.helpText: Check the door leaf for visible damage that could affect its condition or operation.

questions.label: Can the door leaf certification or identification be verified?
questions.helpText: Check for an identification label, plug, mark or other available certification evidence.

questions.label: Are the frame and surrounding wall free from visible damage, distortion or movement?
questions.helpText: Check the frame and surrounding wall for visible damage, distortion, cracking or movement.

questions.label: Can the frame certification or identification be verified?
questions.helpText: Check for available identification, certification or manufacturer information on the frame.

questions.label: Head Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the top of the door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Hinge-side Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the hinge side of the door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Lock-side Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the lock side of the door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Threshold Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the bottom of the door leaf and the finished floor or threshold.

questions.label: Are the correct number and type of fire-rated hinges fitted?
questions.helpText: Check that the fitted hinges are suitable for the fire door and that the required number is present.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the hinges been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the hinges for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Is the required intumescent protection for the hinges present and in good condition?
questions.helpText: Check any visible intumescent protection around the hinges for presence and condition.

questions.label: Are the hinges and visible fixings secure and in good condition?
questions.helpText: Check for loose or damaged hinges and any missing, loose or damaged visible fixings.

questions.label: Are the required intumescent and smoke seals present, continuous, correctly fitted and free from damage or paint?
questions.helpText: Check that the seals are present where required, continuous, secure and free from damage or paint.

questions.label: Is the correct fire-rated latch / lock fitted?
questions.helpText: Check that the fitted latch or lock is suitable for the fire door.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the latch / lock been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the latch or lock for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Is the required intumescent protection for the latch / lock present and in good condition?
questions.helpText: Check any visible intumescent protection around the latch or lock for presence and condition.

questions.label: Does the latch / lock operate correctly?
questions.helpText: Operate the latch or lock and check that it moves and engages correctly.

questions.label: Are the correct fire-rated handles securely fitted?
questions.helpText: Check that the handles are suitable for the fire door and are securely fitted.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the handles been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the handles for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Do the handles operate correctly?
questions.helpText: Operate the handles and check that they move freely and function correctly.

questions.label: Is the self-closing device securely fitted and free from visible damage or leakage?
questions.helpText: Check the self-closing device and its visible fixings for damage, looseness or leakage.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the self-closing device been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the self-closing device for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Does the self-closing device close the door fully into the frame and engage the latch, where fitted?
questions.helpText: Test the self-closing action and check that the door closes fully and engages the latch where fitted.

questions.label: Is the required fire door signage present, secure and legible?
questions.helpText: Check that the required signage is present, securely fitted and clearly readable.

questions.label: Is the fire-rated glazing, including its beads, fixings and seals, secure and free from damage?
questions.helpText: Check the glazing, beads, visible fixings and seals for damage, looseness or deterioration.

questions.label: Does the drop-down seal operate correctly?
questions.helpText: Operate the door and check that the drop-down seal deploys and retracts correctly.

questions.label: Does the door open and close freely without binding?
questions.helpText: Open and close the door and check that it does not rub, stick or bind.

questions.label: Is the door free from wedges or other obstructions that could prevent it closing?
questions.helpText: Check for wedges, objects or other obstructions that could stop the door closing fully.

questions.label: Additional Defects or Observations
questions.placeholder: Add any additional defects or observations.
questions.helpText: Record anything relevant that has not already been captured by the inspection questions.

surveys.name: Double Fire Door Inspection
surveys.description: Inspect the condition and performance of a double fire door.

questions.label: Are both door leaves free from damage?
questions.helpText: Check both door leaves for visible damage that could affect their condition or operation.

questions.label: Can the certification or identification for both door leaves be verified?
questions.helpText: Check both leaves for identification labels, plugs, marks or other available certification evidence.

questions.label: Are the frame and surrounding wall free from visible damage, distortion or movement?
questions.helpText: Check the frame and surrounding wall for visible damage, distortion, cracking or movement.

questions.label: Can the frame certification or identification be verified?
questions.helpText: Check for available identification, certification or manufacturer information on the frame.

questions.label: Left Leaf Head Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the top of the left door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Left Leaf Hinge-side Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the hinge side of the left door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Right Leaf Head Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the top of the right door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Right Leaf Hinge-side Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the hinge side of the right door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Meeting Stile Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the two door leaves at the meeting stile.

questions.label: Left Leaf Threshold Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the bottom of the left door leaf and the finished floor or threshold.

questions.label: Right Leaf Threshold Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the bottom of the right door leaf and the finished floor or threshold.

questions.label: Are the correct number and type of fire-rated hinges fitted to both door leaves?
questions.helpText: Check that both leaves have the required number and type of fire-rated hinges.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the hinges been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the hinges for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Is the required intumescent protection for the hinges on both door leaves present and in good condition?
questions.helpText: Check any visible intumescent protection around the hinges on both leaves for presence and condition.

questions.label: Are the hinges and visible fixings on both door leaves secure and in good condition?
questions.helpText: Check both leaves for loose or damaged hinges and missing, loose or damaged visible fixings.

questions.label: Are the required intumescent and smoke seals present, continuous, correctly fitted and free from damage or paint?
questions.helpText: Check all required seals are present, continuous, secure and free from damage or paint.

questions.label: Is the correct fire-rated latch / lock fitted, where required?
questions.helpText: Check that the fitted latch or lock is suitable for the fire doorset.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the latch / lock been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the latch or lock for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Is the required intumescent protection for the latch / lock present and in good condition?
questions.helpText: Check any visible intumescent protection around the latch or lock for presence and condition.

questions.label: Does the latch / lock operate correctly, where fitted?
questions.helpText: Operate the latch or lock and check that it moves and engages correctly.

questions.label: Are the correct fire-rated handles securely fitted, where required?
questions.helpText: Check that the fitted handles are suitable for the fire doorset and are securely fitted.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the handles been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the handles for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Do the handles operate correctly, where fitted?
questions.helpText: Operate the handles and check that they move freely and function correctly.

questions.label: Are the required self-closing devices securely fitted and free from visible damage or leakage?
questions.helpText: Check the self-closing devices and visible fixings for damage, looseness or leakage.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the self-closing devices been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the self-closing devices for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Do the self-closing devices close both door leaves fully into the frame and engage the latch or closing position, where fitted?
questions.helpText: Test both leaves and check that they close fully into the frame and reach the correct closed position.

questions.label: Do the door leaves close in the correct sequence, where required?
questions.helpText: Where a closing sequence is required, check that the leaves close in the correct order.

questions.label: Is the required fire door signage present, secure and legible?
questions.helpText: Check that the required signage is present, securely fitted and clearly readable.

questions.label: Is the fire-rated glazing, including its beads, fixings and seals, secure and free from damage?
questions.helpText: Check all glazing, beads, visible fixings and seals for damage, looseness or deterioration.

questions.label: Do the drop-down seals operate correctly, where fitted?
questions.helpText: Operate both leaves and check that any fitted drop-down seals deploy and retract correctly.

questions.label: Do both door leaves open and close freely without binding?
questions.helpText: Open and close both leaves and check that neither rubs, sticks or binds.

questions.label: Are both door leaves free from wedges or other obstructions that could prevent them closing?
questions.helpText: Check for wedges, objects or other obstructions that could stop either leaf closing fully.

questions.label: Additional Defects or Observations
questions.placeholder: Add any additional defects or observations.
questions.helpText: Record anything relevant that has not already been captured by the inspection questions.
